input.prompt:
Animate this exact starting frame as a single 3-second head-mounted fisheye running shot.

CAMERA LOCK: The camera is rigidly coupled to Riley's head immediately beneath her chin. It travels forward with her and matches every vertical and rotational movement of her head. Her chin remains pinned to EXACTLY the same screen coordinates as in the starting image, at the same size and distance from the lens throughout. Her face stays locked in the frame. Preserve the starting camera angle and strong fisheye distortion.

BACKGROUND MOTION: Riley runs forward through the station. Roof beams and skylights visibly pass overhead and recede behind her. With each footstep the entire station background shifts up and down and rolls slightly AROUND her anchored face. The camera and Riley move together through the world; the station architecture itself is solid and does not deform. This is a head-attached camera view, with the face steady and the environment moving.

Her shoulders bounce below her fixed chin, her bob flutters, and her lips part with breathless exertion. Keep her identity, anatomical-left mole, white collar, burgundy lanyard, right-shoulder black bag strap, and morning lighting exactly as in the image. Sustain the same running motion through the final frame.

No head bobbing within the frame, stationary background, detached tracking camera, zoom, face morphing, visible rig, or cuts. Sound: panting, rhythmic heel strikes, quiet station ambience. No speech or music.
